title: The conormal sheaf of a nonempty Cartier divisor contained in the closed fibre is not trivial
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file resolve.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a nonempty effective Cartier divisor contained set theoretically in the closed fibre of the vanishing situation, the conormal sheaf of the divisor is not trivial; more precisely some component carries a restriction of positive degree (statement lines 1643-1651). The proof (proof lines 1653-1689) normalizes the divisor by a suitable multiple so that a ratio of valuations is maximal, uses the (S1) property to show that the chosen function vanishes on the divisor, and concludes that a nonzero section of the conormal sheaf has a zero, hence positive degree. H2: a valuation-theoretic normalization with three inputs, written out in full.
